title: Record model and lifecycle transitions
lead:
Define the record schema, its validation, and the status transitions, with a
dated history line appended on every transition.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Core concepts / data model; Milestone 1
boundary: **Not in this slice:** reading or writing files, ID allocation, and the CLI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The model is the core every command builds on. PROJECT.md acceptance requires a
test suite that covers the model transitions.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
The `model` module from the Architecture sketch and its test module (paths set
by Project scaffolding).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Each field from the Core concepts table is present on a record and validated
  (required vs optional per the table; `options` as {label, summary, tradeoffs}).
- Allowed transitions: open -> decided / rejected / withdrawn; decided ->
  superseded. Every other transition raises a validation error.
- Each transition appends one dated history line.
- `created` / `decided_at` are ISO 8601 dates.
- The `kind` handling matches the owner's answer to C21.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement the schema, validation and transition functions in the model module.
`asked_by` / `decided_by` are free-text attribution (C18), not authentication.
Gap: PROJECT.md does not say which fields are required; propose a required set
to the owner in the review if the tests need one.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes, including the new model tests.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
